parts.name: Shader converter: instruction forms
parts.note: Counts and shares are in the figures above.

parts.name: Shader converter: control flow
parts.note: Uniform branches and loops work. Branches that split lanes (exec masks) are partial: exec-mask algebra, skip branches, discard and divergent loops work; branch mode and the remaining shapes are not done.

parts.name: Shader converter: other stages
parts.note: Vertex and compute translators exist with checks in code; their draws are not yet confirmed on both adapters, so only the pixel stage counts as supported. Other stages are not started.

parts.name: GPU memory access
parts.note: Buffer, global and image loads are done. Buffer, global and typed stores, 32-bit atomics and 2D image stores and atomics are partial: lowered only while the lane is provably active; float and 64-bit atomics are refused. LDS is not started.

parts.name: Console Direct3D 12 layer
parts.note: Planned in docs/design/runtime.md: console D3D12 calls translated to desktop D3D12, shaders translated at pipeline creation.

parts.name: System libraries
parts.note: Desktop xmem.dll (graphics and heap memory) only.

parts.name: Native launcher
parts.note: Maps a program and resolves imports through shims, Windows or logged stubs; tested with source-built programs. Implicit TLS and the process's own module identity are not done.

parts.name: Runtime milestone ladder
parts.note: Furthest rung reached: none. Next is R1, a source-built program that starts and exits under the launcher with a machine-readable import report (docs/design/runtime.md, section 6).

parts.name: CPU patch layer
parts.note: No CPU code is patched yet. Only needed for instructions a host CPU lacks.
